assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, road redlines, land ownership, building inventory, municipal utilities, fire access, geotechnical conditions and engineering constraints are not available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: The proposal may define concept-level interfaces and reversible actions, but must not state FAR, height, ownership change, demolition quantity, investment, utility capacity or engineering feasibility as confirmed.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Official planning attachments and discipline-specific survey/engineering documents are released and professionally reviewed.
assumptions.fallback_rule: Keep fixed construction quantities unknown and use low-disturbance, reversible public-interface actions only.

assumptions.statement: The repository provisional research and key-area polygons are temporary intake geometry inferred from public text; they may over-span or misplace the policy entities and must be replaced when official polygons are available.
assumptions.impact: All area, boundary containment, phasing and key-area overlap results based on the provisional polygons are non-statutory and require recomputation.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Official GIS/CAD polygons with a verifiable coordinate reference system are published.
assumptions.fallback_rule: Show provisional geometry with a distinct status and do not calculate statutory area or development capacity.

assumptions.statement: The provisional Origin Community polygon excludes the two announcement anchors Wudaokou and Qinghuadongluxikou; the provisional Dazhongsi polygon lies about 1.7 km from Dazhongsi station at its nearest point and about 2.2 km from the station to its center. Anchor-corrected geometries are explanatory prototypes, not official boundaries.
assumptions.impact: P-B and P-C must be evaluated as anchor-led interface studies. Their area, overlap and project list must be rebuilt after official key-area polygons are issued.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Official polygons for the three detailed-design key areas are published.
assumptions.fallback_rule: Retain station anchors and interface problems, remove any polygon-dependent quantity or implementation claim.

assumptions.statement: The verified evidence supports planar proximity at selected anchors and section samples. It does not establish continuous 100–200 m spacing along the full corridor or strict vertical stacking, burial depth, structural clearance or construction influence among the high-speed railway tunnel, Line 13 and the heritage park.
assumptions.impact: The three layers in drawings are a design-reading framework. No section may be represented as a surveyed engineering cross-section.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Authoritative alignment, level, tunnel, structure and survey drawings are obtained and professionally overlaid.
assumptions.fallback_rule: Use planar diagrams and conditional section candidates; label all vertical relationships as design readings.

assumptions.statement: The Line 13 capacity expansion and split into two lines are public facts, but the final southern alignment, underground sections, retained elevated structures, station construction sequence and opening status relevant to this corridor are not confirmed by the cited source.
assumptions.impact: Design interfaces adjacent to Line 13 must use current-condition and condition-triggered states and cannot depend on a specific future section.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Current official engineering drawings, environmental/planning approvals and construction staging information are released.
assumptions.fallback_rule: Preserve existing operations and provide ground-level, manually operable public connections independent of the upgrade.

assumptions.statement: The published Juesheng Temple source confirms textual protection and construction-control boundaries, but the submission does not have an authoritative vector polygon, verified sightline or project-specific height-control dataset.
assumptions.impact: No fixed facility, building envelope or public-space quantity near Juesheng Temple can be confirmed; concept geometry must remain outside an explicit uncertainty buffer until official overlay review.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Official heritage polygons, control requirements and professional heritage-impact review become available.
assumptions.fallback_rule: Use off-site interpretation, wayfinding and removable facilities; do not infer developable land from textual boundaries.

assumptions.statement: Public-map paths, station entrances, park entrances and building frontages do not by themselves prove 24-hour public access, barrier-free continuity, ownership permission, fire compliance or construction-period availability.
assumptions.impact: Connection counts and public-frontage lengths remain unknown until route, entrance, level-change and access-right attributes are verified.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Field survey, accessibility audit, ownership/access confirmation and current construction information are completed.
assumptions.fallback_rule: Do not count unverified controlled-access space; retain static wayfinding and staffed assistance as non-digital fallback.

assumptions.statement: Qinghe and other blue-green interfaces are identified at concept level, but official river blue lines, flood-control levels, drainage, ecological protection and utility constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Waterfront access points, ecological facilities and area metrics cannot be fixed or represented as approved.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Official water, flood-control, ecology and municipal datasets are supplied and overlaid.
assumptions.fallback_rule: Keep interventions outside uncertain control areas and use monitoring/education proposals without governance claims.

assumptions.statement: Xuebei Park is a verifiable physical project and Xuezhiyuan station is a usable anchor, but their exact administrative, spatial and implementation relationship to the announced Zhongzhiyuan AI Innovation Acceleration Area is not established by the cited public materials.
assumptions.impact: P-A may use Xuebei Park and Xuezhiyuan station as physical anchors but cannot equate the park project with the official Zhongzhiyuan key-area boundary or governance entity.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: An official Zhongzhiyuan boundary, project list or governance document explicitly states the relationship.
assumptions.fallback_rule: Describe the prototype as an anchor-based northern interface and avoid boundary, ownership or delivery claims.

assumptions.statement: Section-level access, frontage, route and interface metrics currently have definitions and failure thresholds but lack complete baseline and proposal geometries.
assumptions.impact: Fourteen performance metrics remain unknown; no target value may be presented as a measured design result before before/after layers are built with the same formula.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Baseline and proposal GeoJSON layers are completed, validated and recomputed in a projected CRS.
assumptions.fallback_rule: Publish formula, missing data and failure condition; keep value null.

assumptions.statement: The Old Tsinghuayuan Station is physically separated from the current corridor. Any memory route is a contemporary interpretive walking route, not a claim that the historic railway alignment survives continuously between the anchors.
assumptions.impact: S06 geometry and graphics must distinguish verified heritage anchors, uncertain historic alignments and newly proposed wayfinding routes.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Historical maps and heritage records are georeferenced and professionally reviewed.
assumptions.fallback_rule: Use point-based interpretation and source-labelled wayfinding; remove any continuous rail-line graphic that cannot be evidenced.

assumptions.statement: Regional coordination with Huairou Science City, Future Science City, Beijing E-Town, the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and Beiwie Community is described at concept level only; no cooperation, resource commitment or data connection has been confirmed by any party, and public facts about the five external nodes have not been verified against registered sources.
assumptions.impact: The proposal may suggest roles, resource exchanges, interfaces, data boundaries and stop conditions for external nodes, but must not state any confirmed partnership, investment, data sharing or institutional commitment.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Official channels publish regional coordination arrangements or the organizer releases authoritative descriptions of the named external nodes.
assumptions.fallback_rule: All spatial structure, metrics and phasing remain valid without any external coordination; treat coordination as incremental upside, not a precondition.
